newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Iran and Zimbabwe to study new oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Iran and Zimbabwe to study new oil refinery.

text.p: Iran and Zimbabwe signed a protocol on Thursday that could lead to the building of an oil refinery in the southern African country.
Zimbabwe's Transport and Energy Minister Simon Moyo said a team of technical experts from the two countries would be set up "soon" to carry out a feasibility study.

"The protocol paves the way for the establishment of an oil refinery here and for a technical team to be set up. The technical team has six months to conclude the feasibility study," Moyo told Reuters.
He said the feasibility study would determine the cost of the refinery.
Zimbabwe imports no oil from Iran. It gets most needs from Kuwait and Moyo said he would like to see Iran supplying more.
